provenance.note: Parents stay in provenance. They are not redrawn as the child’s emblem.

manifest.seal: Proposed seal, not canon: an independent crest over a narrow, revisable question. Parents are not the picture.

operator_instances.title: The Double Root
operator_instances.meaning: Two sources stay identifiable. Two marks are not two people and not a quarrel.

operator_instances.title: The Held Interval
operator_instances.meaning: A measured gap: ache, pause, or what has not yet been decided. It is not a connection.

operator_instances.title: The Attested Bridge
operator_instances.meaning: A graph-authenticated meeting. One instance is one stored join segment, not a mood.

operator_instances.title: The Bounded Aperture
operator_instances.meaning: An inquiry left unclosed. Completeness of this moment is not an answer to everything.

operator_instances.title: The Independent Crest
operator_instances.meaning: A new identity standing beyond its precursors. It does not erase them or fuse them.

operator_instances.title: The Conditional Gate
operator_instances.meaning: A conditional opening. An open gate is not proof that anyone crossed.

operator_instances.title: The Countertrace
operator_instances.meaning: A counterreading: a risk the upright text warns against. It has not been established as fact.
operator_instances.meaning_quote_span: The shadow of Narrow Question is a misreading, not a second event that has already happened. Narrow Question goes wrong when the narrow meeting is inflated into agreement about eve

legend.intro: Codex of Becoming is a new visual grammar for this installation. It is not original canon, not a historical occult system, and not a claim that these shapes were already in the 78. A painted glimmer is not a join. Only a listed CONTACT mark is a stored meeting.
legend.contact_note: 3 CONTACT segments belong to 1 consequential meeting. They are parts of that meeting, not extra agreements.
